reasoning: The icon combines a calendar page with a clock badge, universally understood as date-and-time, scheduling, timetables, or availability. It fits tasks whose actual subject is a schedule, timetable, rota, or calendar management, though it must not be overused on any ordinary task that merely has a deadline or uses the verb 'schedule' (where the object being scheduled should take priority).
